tools.name: choruspay_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (quotes) with pagination. Returns data, has_more and next_cursor. Chorus Pay API: GET /orders.

tools.name: choruspay_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, client, lines, totals and the Chorus Pay link. Chorus Pay API: GET /orders/:id.

tools.name: choruspay_create_order
tools.description: Create an order (quote) with status draft. This tool does not send it to the client. Repeating the same call sends the same Idempotency-Key, so it does not create a second quote. Chorus Pay API: POST /orders.

tools.name: choruspay_update_order
tools.description: Change the redirect URL and/or the metadata of an order. Metadata keys you give are added or overwritten; other keys stay. Chorus Pay API: PATCH /orders/:id.

tools.name: choruspay_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that is cancelled in your shop or tool. Chorus Pay emails the client. Replaying the call is safe. Fails with 409 once the invoice is filed on Chorus Pro. Chorus Pay API: POST /orders/:id/cancel.
